items.control_name: Enforce Cross-Region Backup Copy in AWS Backup Plans
items.description: Primary backup plans must automatically copy recovery points to an alternate disaster recovery region (e.g., us-west-2 -> us-east-1).
items.current_value: Backup plan 'prod-daily-backup' copies snapshots to us-east-1 with 30-day retention
items.recommended_value: Cross-region copy enabled on 100% of production backup plans
items.remediation_notes: Verify KMS encryption key in target destination region supports automated restore.

items.control_name: Configure Automated Forensic EC2 Snapshot Isolation IAM Roles
items.description: Incident response accounts must have pre-authorized IAM roles enabling automated forensic disk snapshot creation upon GuardDuty/Security Hub critical alerts.
items.current_value: IAM Role 'ir-forensic-snapshot-role' active and tested with EventBridge automation
items.recommended_value: Automated IR snapshot isolation role active across all accounts
items.remediation_notes: Review KMS key permissions to ensure forensic team can mount isolated EBS snapshots.

items.control_name: Enforce AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) Continuous Replication for Mission-Critical VMs
items.description: Tier-0 stateful compute workloads must be enrolled in AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) with RPO <= 5 minutes.
items.current_value: DRS replication active on 6 Tier-0 database/app servers; 2 servers pending agent installation
items.recommended_value: 100% DRS replication coverage for Tier-0 workloads
items.remediation_notes: Install AWS DRS replication agent on 'db-prod-legacy-01' and 'app-core-auth'.

items.control_name: Enforce Emergency Break-Glass Account Monitoring & Alerting
items.description: Use of emergency break-glass IAM roles/users must immediately trigger high-priority alerts in PagerDuty/SIEM via EventBridge.
items.recommended_value: Real-time paging & SIEM alert on break-glass credential usage
items.remediation_notes: Test break-glass alert pipeline during semi-annual IR table-top exercises.
